headline: Bids for 2026 BOC referenda self mailers, Veterans Pool design contract amendment, Tidewater Landing award, and Pleasant Street stairway update.
summary: The agenda lists bid openings for printing and mailing 2026 BOC referenda self mailers. It also lists DPW, Planning, and PWSB items, including Tidewater Landing, Veterans Pool, and generators for Fire Stations 3 and 5.
